entries.land_description: New Routes, Inc is a year-round outdoor trip business for women of all ages and all levels of experience. We have two types of trips: one is the purely recreational wilderness trip where relaxation and enjoying the outdoors are the only agenda; the second emphasizes personal and/or professional growth around themes of recovery, empowerment, and spirituality. We have just recently opened a new outdoor center on the coast of Maine where we welcome women to come enjoy our site, camp on the land (for a fee) and participate in our outdoor programs if they wish. At certain times indoor accommodations (a cottage or rooms in the main house) are available.
entries.notes: housing/permanent structures, plumbing, electricity, camping space.

entries.land_description: Woodswomen trips are a way for women to enjoy the outdoors together. We travel by foot, canoe, raft, kayak, horses or llamas, throughout mountains, northern forests, and the deserts of the southwest. Trip participants include a variety of women, 18 to over 70 years old, from many parts of the continent, enjoying each other's company. There are trips designed for beginners and others for experienced outdoorswomen. Our goal is to encourage the spirit of adventure in women - the excitement of seeing new places, the freedom of the outdoors, and the fun of living out childhood or adult dreams.
entries.welcomed_groups: new members/residents, girl/boy children (on a few kids' trips we offer), nonlesbian women

entries.land_description: (located at Virginia Road). Emily's Place, with its 20 acres of women's recreational land, is on Vancouver Island. It offers camping, RV space, or two equipped creekside cabins and outbuildings in a secluded valley. Mountain hiking, skiing, tennis, beachcombing, clamming, canoeing, boating, windsurfing, fresh/salt water fishing, golfing, good dining, country opera and bluegrass festival are all close by. We will pick you up from the Parksville or Coombs bus stops with prior arrangements. Rates are reasonable and are returned to the Emily's Place Project.
entries.welcomed_groups: all Q and all their kids

entries.community_name: RANGIMARIE LESBIAN MOTOR CAMP c/o Gloria Weaver & Chubb Hill; LESBIAN HAVEN ALCOHOL/DRUG REHAB c/o Gloria Weaver & Ilene Wilson
entries.land_description: We are two lesbian-only spaces that are alcohol/drug free. We have been helping lesbians take control over their addictions, based on "tough-love" positive affirmations, and living in an alcohol/drug-free community. We have only been going for 18 months but have already made big progress. We range in age from 5 to 53 years. We recently bought the motor camp, closed it down to the public and now have it as a lesbian-only space. Please don't turn up drunk or drugged or you will be asked to leave. We believe lesbian health, strength and happiness is in living without mind/mood changing substances.
